fieldNotes.location: Roster address 8000 S Orange Ave is wrong (a divisional/distribution listing). Resolved to the actual Frito-Lay manufacturing plant at 2800 Silver Star Rd, Orlando FL 32808 (operating since 1965). Confirmed via web research and satellite: large industrial complex with rooftop snack-food processing equipment, silos, and steam plume.
fieldNotes.closure: PepsiCo/Frito-Lay announced closure of its Orlando facilities Nov 2025; the Silver Star Rd plant ceased operations by May 9, 2026 and per news was being demolished in spring 2026. Maxar imagery and 2025-04 Street View show it operational; audit reflects the physical yard as imaged.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance is off an internal access road that runs south from Silver Star Rd. Chain-link perimeter fence with a sliding/swing gate across the truck lane confirmed in 2025-04 Street View; truck yard is fully fenced.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: A blue canopy structure covers an internal check-in lane just inside the gate; no separate staffed guard booth visible at the road. Treated as remote/kiosk-style check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks observed on both the west face (trailers + canopy docks along the rail side) and the east face (4-5 trailers backed into an east dock apron) — separate clusters on different building faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~28 across west and east faces from zoom-20 imagery; production-side faces obscured by rooftop equipment, so count is approximate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer/box-truck parking yard north of the docks (the staging/parking lot) plus trailer rows along the west rail side.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NW-SE along the west property edge with rail cars/a siding adjacent to the building; appears rail-served, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and large open paved staging area inside the fence give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant complex plus a separate warehouse-style building on the west and a small shop building on the south.
